entries.content:
Started working on the mood board and journal SPAs today. The tag serve system is coming together nicely — being able to serve HTML clips as full applications with a JSON API backend is surprisingly powerful.

The masonry grid for the mood board looks great with the dark theme.

Beautiful spring day. Took the camera out for some street photography. The light was perfect around golden hour — warm and low, casting long shadows across the buildings.

Uploaded a few favorites to the mood board.
